objective: Preserve the 020 failure-recovery curriculum while replacing its stalled repair slot with early, evidence-grounded edit-and-test demonstrations; diagnose reused development only, never train on it.

shared_recipe.candidate_initialization: One action candidate starts from the identical pinned base; fixed 020 recovery is a comparator only. No 021 weights are used.

data.construction: Keep five exact 020 recovery slots per task (275 common records, including every late_repair wrong-edit recovery example). Replace only stall_repair (up to 55 slots) with a successful early repair-and-test command after real bounded source inspection and a real failing declared test. A deterministic repository-stratified half also observes one real missing-file error before returning to allowed sources.
data.sample_selection: All 330 unique complete records. Never truncate history/targets, drop a training task, pad examples or use evaluation feedback as supervision.
data.repair_edit_operator: Existing Python exact literal replacement with all unique anchors checked before writes; set -e stops on edit/test failure.
data.training_token_accounting: Same 330 updates and per-example upper bounds as 020/021; actual training tokens may differ. No equal-token/FLOP claim. CPU data construction is timed separately before the one 12-hour model pipeline.

record_rules.assignment: Sort tasks by repository then task ID; alternate modes within each repository, starting with evidence_then_edit. Assignment never depends on model scores.
record_rules.prefix: First optional missing-file read (real FileNotFoundError, no source edit); then existing locate_command over declared sources; then unpiped declared regression command returning 1. All history is retained and masked.
record_rules.target: One native bash action: set -e, unique-anchor literal repair, then the exact declared regression command. Independently verify the exact restored source passes. Submit is executed as one additional unsupervised action.
record_rules.repair_call: 3 for evidence_then_edit and 4 for missing_read_then_edit; <=12 total calls including completion.
record_rules.length: Whole native input+target <=4096 tokens and target <=512 tokens; never truncate either.
record_rules.fallback: Retain the exact 020 stall_repair row if the complete new example exceeds its limit; record the reason and require coverage >=40 tasks and >=16 per mode before training.
record_rules.no_eval_transfer: No development task prompt, answer, command, source or output becomes training data. The action pattern is constructed anew exclusively on the 55 original training tasks.

partitions.development: Same 15 repeatedly observed development tasks; rerun base, fixed 020 recovery and action once with identical ceilings. Development diagnoses inform the curriculum pattern but no task content enters training.
partitions.historical: All 48 previously observed 020 final tasks, never training or selection
partitions.fresh: The exact 24 repository-disjoint tasks prepared in 021, still model-unopened after its failed development gate. No new task or fresh model score is selected for 022.
partitions.fresh_repository_replacements: Only rights, runtime compatibility, actual clean/broken/restored test controls or reference exposure before any model rollout; retain exclusions. No score-based replacement.

selection.criterion: One new candidate only. Rerun base, frozen 020 recovery and new candidate once on the same 15 development tasks under identical inference ceilings.
selection.if_no_eligible_candidate: Keep final cohorts unopened; record rejection and do not upload candidate weights.

release_gate.weights_release_scope: experimental LoRA adapter plus exact base revision; full merged model only after a separate verified export, never label adapter as complete 27B weights

publication.license_policy: Original code MIT; base and training-source licenses separately preserved. No third-party teacher API outputs.

failure_policy: Build and audit training data on CPU before freezing exact inputs and publishing the protocol. One 12-hour model-pipeline clock covers loaded controls, a single 330-update candidate and evaluation. No score reruns, extra candidates, relaxed gates or deadline extension; retain failed preparation attempts.
limitations: One training seed; small constructed Python/JavaScript tasks and repeatedly observed development.

The new slot combines earlier editing, preserved test-exit status and missing-file recovery. This comparison tests the complete curriculum intervention, not the individual causal contribution of each ingredient.
Reference repairs use licensed training snapshots, not model teachers; no external teacher API or hidden reasoning.
Twenty-four fresh tasks are inherited unopened from 021; four Python repository clusters cannot certify general multilingual coding or long-task quality.
Unknown pretraining overlap; repository separation is not concept separation.
Equal update/call/token ceilings do not mean equal actual token exposure, FLOPs or latency.

reference_adapter.role: frozen development comparator, not an eligible release candidate
